entities.summary: Collective term for the organized center of learning associated with three mosques in the city of timbuktu: the masajids (mosques) of sankore, djinguereber, and sidi yahya Located in Mali. University of Timbuktu is a university in Africa. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
